question: In which of the following cities was the Asian Wrestling Championship 2023 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Astana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Asian Wrestling Championship is a significant annual wrestling event organized by the **Asian Wrestling Federation (AWF).**
 
• The 2023 Asian Wrestling Championships took place from **April 9 to 14 in Astana, Kazakhstan.**
 
• The event was **originally scheduled** to be held in New Delhi, India. 
 
• **22 nations participated** in the 2023 Asian Wrestling Championships with 331 competitors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India secured a total of** 21 medals,** including** 7 gold, 7 silver, and 7 bronze**.
 
• India's Gold Medals:
 
 
• **Vinesh Phogat** (Women's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Bajrang Punia **(Men's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Deepak Punia **(Men's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Anshu Malik **(Women's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Sakshi Malik** (Women's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Amit Dhankar** (Men's Freestyle) - Gold
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya** (Men's Freestyle) - Gold
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** first** Asian Wrestling Championship was held in** Jalandhar, India in 1979.**
 
• The **men's event began in 1979,** and the **women's event was first held in 1996.**
